description: A .NET library or tool packed with dotnet pack and published to nuget.org through trusted publishing
oidcSteps: Exchange OIDC token for a short-lived NuGet key
notes: Set the repository variable NUGET_USER to your nuget.org profile name (not your email). The workflow reads it as vars.NUGET_USER.
On nuget.org, sign in, open your username menu, choose Trusted Publishing, and create a policy with the values above. The policy is yours to create: BaryoVM cannot.
Pushing a v* tag is the publish right: protect v* tags with a repository ruleset, or limit who can push tags.
